fields.FIR_Description: During the evening of 2025-07-07, around 20:10, the cousin of the complainant, Dharani Shankar, aged 23, left for work and could not be contacted afterwards; last seen near Kaveri Park Bus Stand Area in Trichy, according to the complaint recorded on 2025-07-07. The complaint was lodged by Sudha Rani (9000000265), a family member of Dharani Shankar, whose last active mobile number is noted as 9000000003. Vignesh Balan (9000000105) noticed the incident and may be able to provide a statement. The complainant could not identify the person involved. Items referenced in the complaint: photographs and social media screenshots.
fields.Modus_Operandi: Mobile phone allegedly switched off shortly after leaving the campus area.
fields.Keywords: missing person, student, witness, photograph, bus stand, screenshot, evening
